source_request: Make a photorealistic image of an adult handling an architectural wall surface itself like a flexible sheet.
interpreted_intent: An architectural wall surface itself becomes flexible and physically handleable
subject: An adult physically handling an architectural wall surface itself
setting: A smooth concrete building wall beside flat pavement, chosen for this baseline only
event: An adult physically handles a continuous region of an architectural wall as a flexible sheet
visual_priorities: Keep the manipulated material identifiable as the architectural wall itself with an unbroken surrounding connection
Make the adult's contact, limb ownership, reach, and support coherent
Show flexible deformation with legible surface depth while allowing different actions and fold designs
baseline_prompt_en: A photographic portrait frames an adult and an actual architectural wall. The wall surface becomes a flexible sheet; the adult physically handles the wall surface. Beside level pavement, the person draws the concrete surface into a diagonal fold. Their left hand grips its ridge at chest height; their right palm presses its lower slope against the wall. Both hands connect visibly to bent arms, shoulders level and wrists following the contacted planes. Staggered feet bear centered weight on flat pavement. Concrete skin remains continuous with the wall above, below, and beside the fold; aggregate follows its bend. Low side lighting reveals a rounded ridge, compressed crease, and cast shadow on adjoining wall. A wide three-quarter frame preserves both hands, both feet, and the unbroken connection.
